expressions.title: The Dealerships (Cancellation of Agreements and Contracts) Order, 1979
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Islamabad, January 22, 1979, p.13) prints the masthead, No. F. 17(2)/79-Pub. and 'THE DEALERSHIPS (CANCELLATION OF AGREEMENTS AND CONTRACTS) ORDER, 1979, President's Order No. 1 of 1979', Articles 1-2; p2 (p.14) Articles 2(2)-5 and the signatures 'General M. ZIA-UL-HAQ, President' and 'K. M. A. SAMDANI, Secretary' (block 1918785). Ordinance No. III of 1979 (the National Institute of Electronics Ordinance, 1979) begins after it and is cut off after its section 1 at the end of this copy; it is held as document 4005. It is set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
